findings.detail: FOC firmware HIL gate receipt lacks honesty block (structural/teaching/not_rt_servo/not_field_verified). Verdict PASS could be misread as iron FOC closure; smoke only checks file/linker/QEMU structural presence.

Field calibration gate receipt has no honesty tier. Unlike phase-P calibration gate (TEACHING/not_field_verified), S-phase PASS omits teaching-vs-iron disclosure despite FIELD_CALIBRATION_TEACHING_CYCLE oracle and v0 fixture tabu.

Multi-appendage field servo gate receipt omits honesty and deferred_ids. AD_IRON_HIL_PHASE_LOCK is enforced only inside smoke checks, not propagated to moon receipt per plan rule that PASS phases carry known gaps.
F_memory_map_match falsifier is computed then unconditionally overwritten with mmap map_id only, weakening iron-HAL cross-bind verification theater risk in structural HIL receipt.

q_meas is synthesized from q_cmd and teaching_backlash_rad fixture truth, not encoder/iron contact measurement. Pipeline receipt converges to teaching oracle; honest in module docstring but 'field' naming is receipt-tier theater without gate honesty.
Shared servo_tick index only; per-appendage dt diverges (dt_sim 5ms vs dt_iron 50us). F_dt_diverge check documents gap; no cross-stack MMIO phase sync — correctly deferred AD_IRON_HIL_PHASE_LOCK.
FOC RT burst is Python for-loop over ManipulatorLc2IronHal.tick_foc_isr, not hardware kHz ISR. Module/gate label teaching_proxy_not_flight_servo; burst payload lacks explicit not_rt_servo flag.

falsifiers: AD_IRON_HIL_PHASE_LOCK: no iron MMIO phase sync across multi-appendage stacks
field calibration bind != measured friction/contact on iron (teaching sample replay only)
FOC RT slice != flight kHz ISR (Python teaching proxy at pwm_hz contract)
FOC firmware HIL slice == structural file/linker/QEMU presence, not live FOC on iron
multi-appendage shared servo_tick != unified physical clock (per-appendage dt diverge)
LC2 iron HAL encoder motion from teaching integrator, not ATSAMD21 MMIO on bench
